what: 2. The problem: total-indirect-effect tests have a blind spot
title: Power Enhancement for High-Dimensional Mediation: A Guided Tour
text: many mediators, conventional approach summarizes total indirect effect, written beta: sum mediators one’s individual indirect effect. global test checks whether beta = 0. works well mediators push outcome way. consider two active mediators whose individual indirect effects equal size opposite sign: say +0.5 M_1 -0.5 M_2. mediators genuinely active, yet contributions cancel, total indirect effect test built beta sees zero concludes “mediation,” even though two mediators plainly active. rare edge case: whenever different pathways move outcome opposite directions (heterogeneous mediation, extreme contrasting mediation), total indirect effect understates truth test loses power. article calls core limitation existing high-dimensional mediation tests.

title: Power-enhanced test for high-dimensional mediation — pe_mediation
text: Standard high-dimensional mediation tests target total indirect effect \(\beta = \Gamma_x \alpha_m\), sum every mediator's individual indirect effect. indirect effects positive others negative can cancel, making \(\beta = 0\) even though active mediators exist, test built \(\beta\) powerless. power-enhanced test adds component $$J_m = \sqrt{p} \sum_{=1}^{q} \sum_{j \\hat{S}}   \left| \frac{\hat\alpha_{m,j}}{\hat\sigma_{m,j}} \right|   \left| \frac{\hat\Gamma_{x,,j}}{\hat\sigma_{\Gamma,,j}} \right|   \mathbf{1}\!\left\{ \max(p_{1,j}, p_{2,,j}) <   \frac{\alpha_{\mathrm{lvl}}}{s q \log\log n} \right\},$$ sum selected mediators \(\hat S\) product (standardized) mediator--outcome exposure--mediator statistics, kept pairs paths individually significant. \(J_m\) accumulates magnitudes, opposite-signed indirect effects reinforce rather cancel, test \(M_{PE} = S_n + J_m\) stays powerful heterogeneous contrasting mediation keeping chi-square reference distribution (hence Type error rate) benchmark test \(S_n\) global null. indicator also identifies individual mediators active, family-wise error rate control method = "Bonferroni" false discovery rate control "BH" / "".
